name: DEKE VESSEL
note: Doc 27, DEKE VESSEL · Room 3: gates A3, the swindle. Drawn from Tyler's approved attempt 2 (art/staging/room-03/deke-02, generated against Thad in this room, 2026-10-31), keyed, despilled, the five poses registered on his legs by tools/art/cut-ambient-sheet.py, BOX-reduced to the bent curve's man where he stands -- 345 at the bar's end (Tyler, 2026-10-31: 312 too small, 375 'way too big', 345 chosen from four), 428 at 1035,815 since 2026-11-01, the same ruling at his depth -- and graded to the bar men beside him (tools/grade/match-neighbours.py) after Tyler: 'Deke's coloring doesn't match anything else around him'.
whenNote: Doc 57 A3: once the swindle settles "he finishes his drink, collects his hat, and leaves the Nugget. From now on he is not in Room 3." His Room 4 placement keeps its own condition (T_VESSEL_FOUND).
placeNote: AT THE BAR'S NEAR END, FEET LEVEL WITH THE SPITTOON, in the gap between the card table and the first drinker -- Tyler, 2026-11-01: on the open floor 'it feels really weird for him to just be standing in the middle of the room. What about down and to the right so his feet are in line with the spittoon but he's not overlapping the guys behind him?' Rendered at 1000, 1075 and 1080 on that line, then (Tyler, 2026-11-01: 'move Deke slightly to the left so he's not overlapping the guy at the bar at all') at 1030 and 1045: at 1035 his widest pose (frame 3, the hat, 97 px right of centre) ends at 1132, short of the first drinker, and his left touches only the card player's chair back. A whiskey barrel with a drink on it stands at his left (RoomFile.props, Tyler 2026-11-01) so he is not alone on an empty floor. Still facing the batwing doors -- doc 27 LOOK 1, 'watching the door'. History: 1109,655 stood on the first stool's leg; 1060,655 crowded the one-strike man (Tyler: 'I kind of stand on Deke when talking to the gold nugget guy'); 760,730 cleared him but stood alone in the middle of the floor. At 815 he is nearer the camera than the one-strike man's talking spot (1110,640), so the two conversations no longer share ground.
walkToNote: Across the whiskey barrel from him (Tyler, 2026-11-01): the barrel stands at his left, 817-962 at 890,812, so Thad stands on its far side and they talk across it. Was 885,818, the floor at his left, before the barrel took it.

exit.note: Doc 57 A3: once the swindle settles 'he finishes his drink, collects his hat, and leaves the Nugget' -- Tyler, 2026-11-01: 'it would bother me immensely to have a character just disappear.' Six frames generated against Thad's walk-left beside Deke's approved rest pose (art/staging/room-03/deke-walk-01, deke-vessel 3 of 3, reference/room-03/deke-walk/brief.md), keyed, despilled and registered on his torso with his boots on the bottom row by tools/art/cut-walk-sheet.py, BOX-reduced so the passing pose is 428 -- his standing sheet's height, and the curve's man at his mark, so he does not change size as he sets off -- and graded to the bar men (tools/grade/match-neighbours.py, barmen-pixels.npy) as his standing sheet was. PLAYED AS 0, 4, 5, 1, 3, 4, 2, 1 OF THE SHEET, not as drawn: the generator drew contact, pass, contact, contact, pass, contact, and its frames 2 and 3 (and 5 and 0) are OPPOSITE contacts -- 0 and 3 swing his near arm back, 2 and 5 forward -- so in sheet order his legs swapped with no passing pose between them. Reordered, every change of leg goes through a passing pose and both drawings of each contact are used. FPS FROM HIS STRIDE, NOT CHOSEN: the planted foot travels 162 px of the 428 figure from one contact to the next, so a cycle (contact, pass, contact, pass) is 0.76 of his height; on the path's time-weighted man (426) that is 323 px, and at 150 px/s the feet keep pace with the floor at 1.86 poses a second. The brief's placeholder 8 fps would have slid his boots backward across the floor at nearly three times his pace. Each pose is held over 81 px of floor whatever the speed (his stride over four poses); speed and fps move together, and at Thad's 194 px/s it is 2.4. The path goes from his feet in front of the barrel and of Thad to the batwing doors.

barksNote: Doc 07 writes no reputation barks for him: he is a doc 27 tree character, not one of the eighteen ambients.

Room 4: the same five poses re-cut from Tyler's approved sheet at this room's height (530 at his mark, tools/art/cut-ambient-sheet.py) and graded to his own figure as room-04's composition master painted him here (tools/grade/match-neighbours.py). Faces left, toward Thad across the burnt line.
